# Delete the extraction-census cluster the move-first restart abandoned

## Context

On 2026-08-26 the operator reset the Agent OS repository split from zero and replaced the manifest-driven cut with a literal 1:1 move: *"copy paths 1:1 with no topology redesign … No Host/Cloud reclassification, no `ai`->`src` rename, no deploy rearrangement, no migration ledgers."*

That directive removes the **job** of an entire instrument cluster, not just one file. `agentOsExtractionInventory.mjs` exists to emit eligibility rows, Host/Cloud custody classification, plane-opener rows and SHA-bound cut receipts for a manifest-driven cut. `agentOsPlaneBoundaryProof.mjs` proves a plane boundary that is no longer being drawn. Both certify a method that no longer exists.

The trigger was PR `#17803`, which corrected the `enforcement` read-back schema **inside** this instrument. Its stated payoff was unblocking a held manifest emission — the emission the restart deleted. It was closed as scaffolding-polish rather than repaired: the fix was correct in itself and certified nothing.

## The Problem

7996 lines across five files, with no surviving consumer. This is not dormant code that might be useful later; it is an instrument whose measured subject was retired by direction. Left in place it will be copied 1:1 into `neo-agent-brain`, where it becomes permanent inherited weight that a future maintainer must re-derive the irrelevance of.

## The Architectural Reality

Measured at `origin/dev` `514c6709bb`:

| file | lines | role |
|---|---|---|
| `ai/scripts/diagnostics/agentOsExtractionInventory.mjs` | 2556 | the census instrument |
| `ai/scripts/diagnostics/agentOsExtractionInventory.json` | 1845 | its custody-row data |
| `ai/scripts/diagnostics/agentOsPlaneBoundaryProof.mjs` | 1026 | plane-boundary proof built on it |
| `test/playwright/unit/ai/scripts/diagnostics/agentOsExtractionInventory.spec.mjs` | — | inventory spec |
| `test/playwright/unit/ai/services/agentOsPlaneBoundary.spec.mjs` | — | boundary spec |

**Internal edges (why "delete two files" is wrong):**

- `agentOsPlaneBoundaryProof.mjs:17` — `import {SURFACE, buildInventory, rowKey}`; calls `buildInventory()` at `:942`
- `agentOsPlaneBoundary.spec.mjs:17` — `import {SURFACE, rowKey}`
- `agentOsExtractionInventory.spec.mjs:1596` — reads the `.json`

**External edges: none.** The cluster is closed. Verified three ways: no `package.json` script references it, no `.github/` workflow invokes it by path, and no module outside the five imports from it. Deleting all five therefore leaves zero dangling references and requires no inlining or replacement.

## The Fix

Delete all five paths. Nothing is ported, nothing is rewritten.

## Sequencing — time-critical

`ai/**` and `test/playwright/unit/ai/**` are both inside the 1:1 copy set for `neo-agent-brain#13`; @neo-gpt-emmy claimed that receive at 2026-08-26T19:14:49Z. **If this lands after her branch point, Brain inherits all 7996 lines and needs its own deletion pass.** Land it before the receive branch, or agree the branch point with her explicitly.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** All five paths above are deleted from `dev`.
- [ ] **AC-2** Zero dangling references. This returns empty:
      `grep -rn 'agentOsExtractionInventory\|agentOsPlaneBoundaryProof\|buildInventory' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.json' --include='*.yml' ai/ test/ .github/ buildScripts/ package.json | grep -v test-results`
- [ ] **AC-3** Unit suite green — removing the two specs reds nothing else.
- [ ] **AC-4** No replacement module, shim, or re-export is introduced. A deletion that leaves a stub has not happened.

## Out of Scope

- **`resources/content/**` archive mentions.** That tree is the mirrored public record of PRs and Discussions that genuinely referenced this instrument. It documents what happened and must not be rewritten — editing it would falsify history, not clean it.
- **Epic #17500's own closeout.** 14 of its 15 subs are closed and its body still describes the superseded method; reconciling that is a separate, operator-level artifact. It is **not** a precondition for this deletion — see Decision Record impact.
- **The epic's other instruments.** Only this five-file cluster was measured. Other apparatus under the same method may share the fate and needs its own probe before anyone assumes it does.

## Avoided Traps

- **Deleting only the two files PR `#17803` touched.** Orphans the 1845-line `.json` and breaks two live importers. The natural-looking scope is the wrong one.
- **Inlining `SURFACE` / `rowKey` into the surviving specs.** Both specs are themselves part of the abandoned apparatus; inlining preserves the residue under a new name.
- **Judging keeper-ness by whether a file is in the move set.** Membership in `ai/**` is a location proxy for relevance and fails here — the question is whether the subject still has a job, not whether the path travels.

## Decision Record impact

**`challenges` Epic #17500 — corrected.** This ticket was filed asserting `none`; that was wrong and is retracted here rather than in a comment.

These files are not incidental scaffolding under the epic — they **are** its first two blocking proofs, in the epic's own words:

> **Exact inventory** | every executable, root command, workflow reference, config authority, and custody decision is the **first blocking Epic proof**; receipt linked before any relocation leaf

> The exact inventory/membership reconciliation and the temporary C′ paired-gate exercise are the Epic's **first two blocking proofs**. Per the explicit criteria-timing amendment at `DC_kwDODSospM4BFFq_`, both receipts must be linked here before any relocation leaf starts.

`agentOsExtractionInventory.mjs` is that exact-inventory instrument; `agentOsPlaneBoundaryProof.mjs` is the membership-and-denial paired proof (epic body, membership + denial row). The epic further gates a `shared/` package on the inventory *proving* a cross-plane population, and its Governance row requires an ADR plus STEP_BACK receipts. The criteria-timing amendment is a Discussion #17489 comment, so the ideation sandbox governs this too.

**But the mandate is DISCHARGED, which is the part that decides this ticket.** Both proof subs are **closed**: #17525 *Build the zero-residue AgentOS extraction inventory* and #17533 *Exercise the isolated AgentOS plane boundary before relocation*. 14 of the epic's 15 subs are closed. The receipts these instruments existed to produce were produced and linked. They are **spent scaffolding, not a live gate.**

The one open sub is #17786, *Execute the Agent OS repository cut* — the relocation itself, and the move-first restart replaced its method outright.

## No blocking dependency

An earlier revision of this body set `blocked_by #17500` and required the epic's disposition before merge. **That was wrong and the relationship has been removed.** A gate that has already fired is not a gate: nothing pending consumes these instruments, so nothing is orphaned by deleting them. Blocking a deletion behind a discharged proof would have stalled real work behind ceremony — the exact failure mode this cleanup exists to end.

**This ticket is unblocked.** Epic #17500's own closeout (its body still describes a method the restart replaced) is separate, operator-level, and not a precondition here.

## Structure Map Gate (§1c)

N/A — pure deletion. No file is created or relocated, so there is no placement to validate. `ai/scripts/diagnostics/` is unchanged for its remaining occupants.
